product_context.primary_task: Configure, run, and inspect a quantum experiment
assumptions: Users may work with complex parameter sets

archetype.rationale: Researchers need a persistent experiment surface, editable configuration, and inspectable results.
alternatives_rejected: Command Surface alone: visual experiment state must remain inspectable

regions.responsibility: Construct and inspect experiment or circuit
Edit selected operation and runtime parameters
Show logs, progress, and runtime feedback

navigation_model.global: Native application menu and project navigation

structural_changes: Console can be docked or collapsed
Console collapses without losing running-state visibility

interaction_map.feedback: Display execution state, cancellation, and logs

decisions: Keep runtime status visible during execution
Separate editable configuration from immutable result evidence

validation.task_clarity: Experiment construction and execution are the central workflow
validation.platform_fit: Supports desktop density, keyboard shortcuts, resizable panes, and native menus
validation.accessibility_review: Keyboard-operable graph alternative and explicit focus management required
